title: JVM Diagnostics and Tuning Workflow
contentMd:
When a JVM misbehaves in production the first instinct is to restart it, and that destroys the evidence. A better reflex is to capture observable state first: thread dumps with jstack, a live histogram with jmap -histo, GC statistics with jstat -gcutil, and a continuous JFR recording if the JDK permits one. On a modern JDK, jcmd is the single entry point that subsumes most of these diagnostics.

Always enable -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError with an explicit HeapDumpPath, and enable GC logging with -Xlog:gc* on JDK 9 and later. Those flags cost almost nothing during normal operation and are the difference between a postmortem with evidence and one built on guesses. Take thread dumps as a burst of three spaced a few seconds apart, so you can distinguish genuinely blocked or waiting threads from threads merely parked in an idle pool.

Tuning starts by naming the goal: throughput, latency tail percentiles, or memory footprint. Only one of them can be optimized truly. For throughput, size the heap generously and consider Parallel GC. For latency, prefer G1 with an explicit -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis target, or ZGC and Shenandoah when you need low pauses over very large heaps. Never copy another teams heap sizes and flags wholesale.

Finally treat tuning as a measurement loop. Change one flag, benchmark with JMH or real traffic for a full business cycle, compare against the baseline, then keep or revert. Most durable wins come from reducing allocation rate and shortening object lifetimes in your own code, not from exotic garbage collector parameters.
contentCn:
当 JVM 在生产环境出现异常时，第一反应往往是重启它，而重启会销毁证据。更好的习惯是先采集可观测状态：用 jstack 抓线程快照，用 jmap -histo 看实时对象直方图，用 jstat -gcutil 看 GC 统计，如果 JDK 支持就开启连续的 JFR 录制。在现代 JDK 上，jcmd 是统摄这些诊断手段的统一入口。

务必开启 -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError 并配上明确的 HeapDumpPath，同时在 JDK 9 及以后使用 -Xlog:gc* 打开 GC 日志。这些参数在正常运行期间几乎不带来开销，却是「有据可查的复盘」与「全靠猜测的复盘」之间的区别。抓线程快照时要连着抓三份、每份间隔几秒，这样你才能区分真正被阻塞或等待的线程与只是空闲停在线程池里的线程。

调优的第一步是明确目标：吞吐量、延迟分位值，还是内存占用。三者之中真正能被优化到极致的通常只有一个。追求吞吐就给较大的堆并考虑 Parallel GC；追求延迟则倾向 G1 并显式设置 -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis，或者在超大堆上需要极低暂停时选择 ZGC、Shenandoah。永远不要照搬别的团队的堆大小和 GC 参数。

最后把调优当成测量闭环：一次只改一个参数，用 JMH 或真实流量跑满一个完整业务周期，与基线对比后再决定保留或回滚。多数可持续的性能收益来自降低分配速率、缩短对象生命周期这类代码层面的改进，而不是各种奇特的垃圾回收器参数。

title: Troubleshooting OutOfMemoryError
contentMd:
OutOfMemoryError is a symptom, not a root cause. The message text tells you which memory area ran out, and each message points at a different class of bug: Java heap space, Metaspace, unable to create new native thread, Direct buffer memory, or GC overhead limit exceeded.

Java heap space means objects are still reachable from GC roots. Take a heap dump and inspect the dominator tree: usually one collection or cache retains millions of entries. Common culprits are unbounded caches, queries without pagination that load a whole result set into memory, and ThreadLocal maps that survive because the thread never dies. Metaspace almost always means dynamic class generation: reflection proxies, script engines, or a classloader leak where the old loader is still referenced by a static field or by a running threads contextClassLoader.

Direct buffer memory means off-heap ByteBuffers were allocated faster than their cleaner ran, typical when Netty pooled buffers are never released or when MaxDirectMemorySize is left unset. The message unable to create a new native thread is not really about memory: you hit the operating system thread limit, usually by creating a thread per request instead of using a pool. GC overhead limit exceeded means the JVM spent most of its time collecting and recovering almost nothing, which is nearly always a leak rather than a heap that is merely too small.

The practical workflow stays the same: capture the dump with HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError, open it in MAT or JProfiler, compute retained sizes, and walk the path to GC roots until you find who owns the references. Fix that ownership bug. Raising -Xmx only moves the crash further into the future.
contentCn:
OutOfMemoryError 是症状，不是根因。异常信息里的文字会告诉你是哪块内存耗尽了，而每一条信息都指向不同类别的缺陷：Java heap space、Metaspace、unable to create new native thread、Direct buffer memory，或者 GC overhead limit exceeded。

Java heap space 表示对象仍然从 GC Roots 可达。先取堆快照再看支配树：通常是一个集合或缓存保留了数以百万计的条目。常见元凶包括无界缓存、没有分页而把整个结果集加载进内存的查询，以及因为线程永不消亡而长期存活的 ThreadLocal map。Metaspace 几乎总是意味着动态生成类：反射代理、脚本引擎，或者类加载器泄漏——旧的加载器仍被某个静态字段或某个运行线程的 contextClassLoader 引用着。

Direct buffer memory 表示堆外 ByteBuffer 的分配速度快于其清理器的执行速度，典型场景是 Netty 池化 buffer 从未释放，或者根本没设置 MaxDirectMemorySize。unable to create a new native thread 其实并不真是内存问题：你触到了操作系统的线程上限，通常是因为每条请求都新建线程而没使用线程池。GC overhead limit exceeded 表示 JVM 绝大部分时间在做垃圾收集却几乎回收不出空间，这几乎总是内存泄漏，而不是堆「仅仅有点小」。

实操流程始终一致：用 HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError 抓到快照，在 MAT 或 JProfiler 里打开，计算保留大小，沿着到 GC Roots 的引用路径一直走到找出持有者为止，然后修掉那个所有权缺陷。单纯调大 -Xmx 只是把崩溃推得更远一点。

title: Class Loading and the Parent Delegation Model
contentMd:
Java class loading follows three phases: loading, linking (verification, preparation, resolution), and initialization, all performed by ClassLoader instances arranged in a delegation hierarchy. Bootstrap loads classes from the base JDK modules, Platform handles JDK-provided classes outside those modules, Application loads your classpath, and custom loaders hang below them.

The parent delegation model says a loader first asks its parent to load the class and only attempts it itself when the parent cannot find it. This yields two guarantees: a class is loaded once by the highest loader that can see it, and core JDK classes cannot be replaced by something planted on the classpath. It also explains jar hell: when two versions of a library exist, only the one visible to the earliest loader wins, and the loser fails at runtime rather than at build time.

Delegation is deliberately broken in a few well-known cases. Servlet containers use child-first loaders so a web application can ship its own logging framework version; historically JDBC relied on the thread context classloader because ServiceLoader in the bootstrap layer had to see driver classes living in the application layer; OSGi and modern plugin systems replace the linear hierarchy with explicit import and export declarations.

Every loader plus its classes forms its own namespace. Two classes with the same name loaded by different loaders are genuinely different types, so casting between them throws ClassCastException even though the class names match. That is why singletons appear to double, why instanceof behaves surprisingly, and why plugin frameworks are so careful about which loader owns shared interfaces.
contentCn:
Java 的类加载分为三个阶段：加载、链接（校验、准备、解析）和初始化，全部由按委派层级组织起来的 ClassLoader 实例完成。Bootstrap 负责加载基础 JDK 模块中的类，Platform 负责这些模块之外的 JDK 类，Application 负责应用类路径，自定义加载器则挂在它们下面。

双亲委派模型规定：加载器先请父加载器去加载某个类，只有当父加载器找不到时才由自己尝试。这带来两点保证：同一个类只会被「能看到它的最高层加载器」加载一次，以及核心 JDK 类无法被塞进类路径的冒牌实现替换掉。它也解释了 jar hell：当某个库同时存在两个版本时，只有最早可见的那个胜出，落败的一方在运行期而非编译期才炸。

在若干众所周知的场景中，委派是被有意打破的。Servlet 容器使用「子优先」加载器，好让 Web 应用自带一套日志框架版本；历史上 JDBC 依赖线程上下文类加载器，因为 bootstrap 层里的 ServiceLoader 必须看见位于应用层中的驱动类；OSGi 以及现代插件体系则用显式的 import/export 声明取代线性层级。

每个加载器连同它加载的类构成一个独立的命名空间。同名类被不同加载器加载后就是真正不同的类型，即便类名完全相同，互相强转也会抛 ClassCastException。这正是「单例出现了两份」、instanceof 表现诡异的原因，也是插件框架必须谨慎决定共享接口由哪个加载器持有的原因。
titleEn: Class Loading and the Parent Delegation Model
titleCn: 类加载与双亲委派模型

title: Escape Analysis and Lock Elision
contentMd:
Escape analysis is a JIT-time determination of whether an object created inside a method can be observed outside that method or that thread. If it cannot escape, the compiler is free to break the illusion of heap allocation: it can scalar-replace the object, keeping its fields in registers, or eliminate the allocation entirely, so that in the compiled code the object never truly exists.

Its most valuable consequence for backend code is lock elision. A synchronized block needs a real monitor only when the lock object is shared and contended. When the JIT can prove a lock never escapes the current thread it removes the synchronization altogether. This is why legacy code still using StringBuffer or synchronized collections inside a request-scoped method often costs almost nothing once warmed up: after compilation the locks simply vanish.

For hot methods the JIT can also perform lock coarsening, merging adjacent synchronized blocks on the same monitor into a single acquisition and release. Note the boundaries carefully. These optimizations apply to compiled code, so interpreted calls during warmup still pay the full cost; they are disabled altogether under -Xint; and the analysis only reaches through callees that were actually inlined.

Do not design code that depends on elision, though. Keep preferring StringBuilder over StringBuffer and picking unsynchronized collections deliberately, because elision is an optimization the compiler may decline rather than a semantic guarantee. Confirm what really happened with JITWatch, JFR compilation events, or -XX:+PrintAssembly.
contentCn:
逃逸分析是 JIT 在编译期做出的判断：某个方法内部创建的对象，是否可能被该方法或该线程之外观察到。如果它不会逃逸，编译器就可以打破「必须在堆上分配」的假象：它可以做标量替换，把对象字段直接放在寄存器里，甚至完全消除这次分配——在编译后的代码中，这个对象其实从未真正存在过。

对后端代码而言最有价值的推论是锁消除。synchronized 只有在锁对象被多线程共享并争用时才需要真正的管程。当 JIT 能证明某个锁不会逃逸出当前线程时，它会把同步全部去掉。这就是为什么遗留代码里仍在某个请求级方法内使用 StringBuffer 或同步集合，预热完成后开销往往近似为零：编译之后这些锁直接消失了。

对于热点方法，JIT 还能进行锁粗化，把相邻的对同一把 monitor 的同步块合并成一次加锁与释放。这里要注意它的边界：这些优化只作用于已编译的代码，预热期间解释执行的调用仍要付全额成本；在 -Xint 下它们完全不生效；而且分析只能穿透真正被内联进来的被调用方法。

但也不要写出依赖锁消除的代码。依然应优先用 StringBuilder 而不是 StringBuffer，依然要自觉地挑选非同步集合，因为「消除」只是编译器可以选择不做的优化，而非语义上的保证。想知道真实发生了什么，就用 JITWatch、JFR 的编译事件或 -XX:+PrintAssembly 去确认。

title: JIT Compilation and Tiered Compilation
contentMd:
HotSpot does not interpret bytecode forever. It starts in the interpreter, counts method invocations and loop back edges, and once thresholds are crossed it queues the method for compilation. C1 applies quick, light optimization; C2 applies aggressive optimization based on collected profiles. Tiered compilation runs interpreter, C1 and C2 together and promotes or deoptimizes code between them as its behavior changes.

C2 performs inlining, loop unrolling, range check elimination, type sharpening via class hierarchy analysis, and speculative optimization guarded by uncommon traps. When an assumption breaks, typically because a newly loaded subclass turns a monomorphic call site polymorphic, the compiled code deoptimizes back to the interpreter and is later recompiled with the corrected profile. That cycle is exactly why steady-state benchmarks must warm up before their numbers mean anything.

Three consequences matter for backend services. First, compilation decisions are per method and profile driven, so identical source on a hot path and a cold path behaves very differently. Second, the code cache is finite; once it fills, JIT stops compiling and the JVM quietly degrades toward interpreted-only execution, which you tune with ReservedCodeCacheSize. Third, lock elision and other thread-level optimizations happen here, not in the interpreter, so the sync cost you measure is a function of how warm the method is.

When diagnosing performance, always separate warmup from steady state. Use JMH, which forks JVMs and controls warmup iterations precisely, and read -XX:+PrintCompilation or JFR compilation events. Never draw conclusions from the first few seconds of a service's life.
contentCn:
HotSpot 不会永远以解释方式执行字节码。它先由解释器执行，并统计方法调用次数与循环回边次数；一旦越过阈值就把方法排入编译队列。C1 做快速而轻量的优化，C2 基于收集到的剖面信息做激进优化。分层编译把解释器、C1、C2 三者同时跑起来，并随着代码行为的变化在各层之间提升或去优化。

C2 会做内联、循环展开、边界检查消除、基于类层次分析的类型锐化，以及由 uncommon trap 兜底的投机性优化。一旦某个假设失效——典型情况是某个新加载的子类让原本单态的调用点变成多态——已编译的代码就会去优化回解释器，稍后再依据修正后的剖面重新编译。正因为存在这个循环，稳态基准测试必须先预热，否则结果毫无意义。

对后端服务而言有三点影响值得牢记。其一，编译决策是按方法并基于剖面做出的，所以同一份源码在热路径与冷路径上表现差异极大。其二，Code Cache 是有限的；一旦写满，JIT 就停止编译，JVM 会悄悄退化到近乎纯解释执行的状态，可用 ReservedCodeCacheSize 调整。其三，锁消除等优化发生在这里而不是解释器里，因此你测得的同步开销取决于方法的预热程度。

做性能诊断时，务必把预热期与稳态区分开来。使用 JMH，它会 fork JVM 并精确控制预热迭代；同时结合 -XX:+PrintCompilation 或 JFR 的编译事件来观察。绝不要根据服务启动最初几秒的表现下结论。

title: Thread Pool Sizing and Rejection Policies
contentMd:
Sizing a thread pool starts with classifying the workload. CPU-bound work wants roughly one thread per core, with N+1 as a reasonable default so a single stall does not idle the CPU. IO-bound work is sized by the wait-to-compute ratio: threads = cores multiplied by (1 + wait/compute). That ratio, not the core count alone, decides whether more threads help or merely add context switches. If you cannot measure it, use a bounded queue and grow empirically until throughput plateaus.

The ThreadPoolExecutor lifecycle matters more than the numbers. Tasks go to core threads first, then to the queue, then to extra threads up to maximumPoolSize, and only then do rejection handlers run. This surprises people who combine a huge core size with an unbounded LinkedBlockingQueue: the queue never fills, so maximumPoolSize becomes inert and you get unbounded memory growth instead of backpressure.

Rejection policies encode what happens when you lose. AbortPolicy throws RejectedExecutionException and is the default for good reason: it forces the caller to respond. CallerRunsPolicy makes the submitting thread run the task itself, which throttles producers naturally and works as a simple rate limiter. DiscardPolicy drops work silently and DiscardOldestPolicy drops the oldest queued item; both are acceptable only for idempotent, low-value work such asMetrics sampling.

Production essentials: give threads meaningful names so dumps are readable, wrap every task in try/catch because an escaping exception kills the worker, and export queue depth, active count and rejection count as metrics. Remember too that CompletableFuture and parallel streams share the common ForkJoinPool unless you supply your own executor.
contentCn:
线程池的容量规划从划分负载类型开始。CPU 密集型任务大约一个核心一个线程，通常取 N+1 作为默认值，让个别停顿不至于让 CPU 空转。IO 密集型任务则按「等待时间/计算时间」的比例来定：线程数 = 核数 ×（1 + 等待/计算）。决定加线程是否有用的，是这个比例而不是单纯的核数。如果暂时测不出这个比例，就用有界队列，边压测边扩容，直到吞吐不再增长为止。

ThreadPoolExecutor 的执行顺序比具体数值更重要：任务先交给核心线程，核心满了进队列，队列满了才创建直到 maximumPoolSize 的额外线程，最后才会触发拒绝策略。这一点常令使用 Executors 默认工厂的人措手不及：把核心线程数配得很大再配上无界 LinkedBlockingQueue，队列永远填不满，maximumPoolSize 就成了摆设，你得到的是无界的内存增长而不是背压。

拒绝策略决定了「扛不住时怎么办」。AbortPolicy 抛出 RejectedExecutionException，它是默认值且很合理：逼迫调用方去处理。CallerRunsPolicy 让提交任务的线程自己执行该任务，从而天然地抑制生产者，相当于一个简易限流器。DiscardPolicy 静默丢弃任务，DiscardOldestPolicy 丢弃队列中最老的任务；两者只对幂等且价值不高的任务才可接受，比如指标采样。

生产环境的要点：给线程起有意义的名字以便线程快照可读，每个任务都用 try/catch 包住——逃逸出去的异常会杀掉工作线程，并把队列深度、活跃线程数和拒绝次数做成可观测metrics指标。还要记得 CompletableFuture 与并行流默认共用公共 ForkJoinPool，除非你显式传入自己的执行器。
titleEn: Thread Pool Sizing and Rejection Policies
titleCn: 线程池容量规划与拒绝策略

title: ThreadLocal and Its Memory Leaks
contentMd:
A ThreadLocal stores a per-thread value in a map that lives on each Thread object. Threads in a pool never die, so the entry survives for the entire life of the pool. That persistence is exactly what makes the mechanism useful, and exactly what makes it dangerous.

In that map the keys are weak references to the ThreadLocal instance while the values are strong references. When the ThreadLocal variable itself becomes unreachable, the key is cleared to null but the value remains reachable through the chain thread -> threadLocals -> entry -> value. This is the classic ThreadLocal leak: nothing removes the entry until the thread dies, and in a servlet container or pooled executor the thread never dies, so every request piles up objects that cannot be collected.

Rules for safe use follow directly from that mechanism. Always call remove() in a finally block within the same request or task scope. Never stash a user request object or a large object graph; copy only what you actually need. Prefer explicit method parameters when the value could simply be passed down, and remember that InheritableThreadLocal copies parent values into child threads, which combines badly with dynamically resized pools and produces stale or leaked contexts.

When you must share a whole request context, bind its lifetime to something narrower than the thread. A wrapper object cleared by a filter works, and on JDK 21 and later ScopedValue expresses the same intent properly: the value exists only inside the scoped run block, is immutable, and unwinds automatically, so no remove() discipline is required at all.
contentCn:
ThreadLocal 会把每个线程各自的值存放在挂在 Thread 对象上的一个 map 里。线程池中的线程永不消亡，因此其中的条目会在整个池的生命周期内存活。这种持久性正是它有用的地方，也正是它危险的地方。

在这个 map 中，键是对 ThreadLocal 实例的弱引用，而值是强引用。当 ThreadLocal 变量本身变得不可达时，键会被置为 null，但值仍然沿着「线程 -> threadLocals -> entry -> value」这条引用链可达。这就是经典的 ThreadLocal 泄漏：除非线程死亡，否则没人会移除这个条目；而在 Servlet 容器或线程池执行器中线程根本不会死，于是每个请求都在堆积无法回收的对象。

安全使用的规则直接源于上述机制。始终在同一个请求或任务作用域内的 finally 块里调用 remove()。不要把整个请求对象或大型对象图塞进去，只复制真正需要的字段。当该值本来就可以通过参数传递时，优先用显式方法参数。还要记得 InheritableThreadLocal 会把父线程的值复制给子线程，这与动态伸缩的线程池叠加时会产生过期甚至泄漏的上下文。

当确实必须共享整个请求上下文时，要把它的生命周期绑定到比线程更窄的东西上。用由过滤器清理的包装对象是一种做法；在 JDK 21 及以后，ScopedValue 则把同样的意图表达得更彻底：值只存在于作用域运行块内部、不可变、且自动退出作用域，因此完全不需要靠手工 remove() 来维系。

title: Composing Asynchronous Work with CompletableFuture
contentMd:
CompletableFuture is both a future you can complete later and a promise of a stage-based pipeline. Its power is composition: thenApply transforms the value synchronously on whichever thread completes the previous stage, thenCompose flattens a nested future so you never produce Future nested in Future, thenCombine merges two independent results, and allOf waits for many futures but returns Void, so you still join them individually to collect values.

Exception semantics are where candidates stumble. An exception travels down the pipeline and skips every dependent stage until it meets exceptionally, handle, or whenComplete. exceptionally sees only the failure, handle sees both value and throwable, and whenComplete observes the outcome without transforming it. Always terminate every pipeline with a handler, otherwise an exception thrown inside a fire-and-forget call disappears without a trace.

Control over which thread runs each stage is the second common misunderstanding. Without an explicit executor, thenApply runs on whatever thread completed the previous stage, while the Async suffixed variants run on your executor or, if you pass none, on the common ForkJoinPool. Blocking IO in the common pool starves every other consumer, especially parallel streams, so always pass your own executor for anything that blocks.

Round out the toolkit with details interviewers like: orTimeout and completeOnTimeout arrived in JDK 9, getNow avoids blocking, and plain get must always carry a timeout. Also note that exceptionally placed before other stages will not rescue failures thrown downstream, and that joining inside a thenApply buried in a callback chain can silently reintroduce the blocking you were trying to remove.
contentCn:
CompletableFuture 既是一个可以在以后被完成的 future，也是一个阶段性流水线的 promise。它的威力在于组合：thenApply 在「完成上一个阶段的那个线程」上同步转换结果，thenCompose 把嵌套的 future 展平从而避免 Future 套 Future 的形态，thenCombine 合并两个独立结果，allOf 等待多个 future 但返回 Void，因此仍需逐个 join 才能拿到各自的值。

异常语义是最容易出错的地方。异常会沿着流水线向下传播并跳过后续所有依赖阶段，直到遇到 exceptionally、handle 或 whenComplete。exceptionally 只看到失败，handle 同时看到值与异常，而 whenComplete 观察结果但不改变它。每个流水线都要用一个处理器收尾，否则在「发射即忘」的调用里抛出的异常会消失得无影无踪。

第二个常见误解是「哪个阶段由哪个线程执行」。若不显式指定执行器，thenApply 就跑在完成上一个阶段的那个线程上；带 Async 后缀的变体则跑在你传入的执行器上，若没传就跑在公共 ForkJoinPool 上。在公共池里执行阻塞式 IO 会饿死其他所有使用方——尤其是并行流——因此凡是会阻塞的任务都要显式传入自己的执行器。

再补几处面试官爱问的细节：orTimeout 与 completeOnTimeout 自 JDK 9 起提供，getNow 不会阻塞，而普通的 get 必须始终带上超时。还要注意：放在其他阶段之前的 exceptionally 救不了下游抛出的异常；而在回调链里的 thenApply 中调用 join，会把你本想消除的阻塞悄悄请回来。
titleCn: 用 CompletableFuture 组合异步任务

title: synchronized vs ReentrantLock vs CAS
contentMd:
synchronized is a JVM-level monitor. The runtime escalates it through biased, lightweight CAS-based, and heavyweight OS-parked states as contention grows, and biased locking was deprecated and removed in recent JDKs. It is reentrant, and critically it releases automatically on every exit path including exceptions. That safety plus decades of JVM optimization make it the correct default for ordinary mutual exclusion.

ReentrantLock exists for what synchronized cannot express: tryLock with a timeout, lockInterruptibly, an optional fair queue, and Condition objects giving multiple independent wait sets per lock. The cost is discipline: you must unlock in a finally block, because a leaked monitor blocks every other thread forever with no stack to show where it leaked. Reach for it when you need timeout, interruptibility, or the signaling pattern used inside pools and blocking queues.

CAS-based primitives are a different tool entirely. AtomicInteger, LongAdder, and StampedLock optimistic reads are lock-free and win under low to moderate contention, but they solve a smaller problem: atomic mutation of a single variable. You cannot update two invariants together with one CAS, so composite operations still need a real lock. Under heavy contention CAS also burns CPU spinning and retrying, which is precisely why LongAdder stripes writes across cells and beats AtomicLong on contended counters.

The decision rule is simple. Start with synchronized for correctness and simplicity, keep critical sections tiny, and never hold a lock across IO or remote calls. Move to ReentrantLock only when you need its specific features, and use atomics for single-variable state such as counters, flags and sequence numbers.
contentCn:
synchronized 是 JVM 级别的管程。随着竞争加剧，运行时会在偏向锁、基于 CAS 的轻量级锁以及依赖操作系统挂起的重量级锁之间逐级升级；偏向锁在近期的 JDK 中已被废弃并移除。它是可重入的，而且最关键的一点是在所有退出路径上——包括抛出异常时——都会自动释放。这种安全性叠加 JVM 多年的优化，使它成为普通互斥场景的正确默认选择。

ReentrantLock 存在的理由是 synchronized 表达不了的能力：带超时的 tryLock、可中断的 lockInterruptibly、可选的公平队列，以及能在一把锁上提供多个独立等待集的 Condition 对象。代价是纪律性：你必须在 finally 块里 unlock，因为一旦泄漏，其他线程会被永久阻塞，而现场又没有任何栈能指出泄漏发生在哪。只有当你确实需要超时、可中断，或需要线程池与阻塞队列里那种条件通知模式时才用它。

基于 CAS 的原语则完全是另一类工具。AtomicInteger、LongAdder 以及 StampedLock 的乐观读都是无锁的，在低到中等竞争下表现最好，但它们解决的问题更小：单个变量的原子修改。你无法用一次 CAS 原子地更新两个不变量，因此复合操作仍然需要真正的锁。在高竞争下 CAS 还会因自旋重试而空烧 CPU，这也正是 LongAdder 把写入分散到多个 cell、从而在竞争激烈的计数器场景胜过 AtomicLong 的原因。

决策规则很简单：先用 synchronized 保证正确性且保持简洁，把临界区做得极小，绝不在持锁期间做 IO 或远程调用；只有在确实需要某特性时才换 ReentrantLock；用原子类处理计数器、标志位、序列号这类单变量状态。
titleCn: synchronized、ReentrantLock 与 CAS 的取舍

title: Java Agents and Bytecode Instrumentation
contentMd:
A Java agent is a jar whose manifest declares Premain-Class or Agentmain-Class. premain runs before your main method, which lets you register a ClassFileTransformer and rewrite every class as it is loaded. agentmain attaches to an already running process through the Attach API and typically retransforms classes, which requires Can-Retransform-Classes to be declared.

Writing raw class bytes by hand is error prone, so everyone builds on a library. ASM exposes low-level visitor APIs and powers most frameworks; Javassist offers a source-like API; ByteBuddy provides a fluent, type-safe DSL and is what modern observability agents use. A transformer sees every class it did not ask about, so it must fail fast, keep the type filter tight, and stay idempotent.

This mechanism is the invisible backbone of the Java ecosystem. APM tools such as SkyWalking, Pinpoint and the OpenTelemetry Java agent inject tracing and metrics around JDBC connections, servlet entry points and RPC clients. Mockito inline mock maker mocks final classes and static methods. JaCoCo computes coverage from an on-the-fly transformer, and JRebel or HotSwapAgent reload changed classes, constrained by the rule that redefinition may change method bodies but cannot add or remove methods and fields.

Two costs are worth stating honestly. Transformation adds class loading work and therefore startup latency, and a buggy transformer can hang the whole JVM at bootstrap because it runs inside the class loading path. Keep agents optional behind a flag, guard expensive work behind configuration, and always measure the added startup time before enabling one by default.
contentCn:
Java Agent 是一个 jar，其 manifest 中声明了 Premain-Class 或 Agentmain-Class。premain 在你的 main 方法之前运行，因此你可以注册 ClassFileTransformer，在每个类被加载时就改写它的字节码。agentmain 则通过 Attach API 附加到已经在运行的进程上，通常是重新转换（retransform）已有的类，这需要在 manifest 中声明 Can-Retransform-Classes。

手工编写原始类字节极易出错，因此业界都基于库来做。ASM 提供底层的访问者 API，多数框架都构建于它之上；Javassist 提供接近源码风格的 API；ByteBuddy 提供流式且类型安全的 DSL，现代可观测性 agent 基本都用它。转换器会看到所有它并未申请处理的类，所以它必须快速失败、把类型过滤写得尽量收紧，并且保持幂等。

这套机制是 Java 生态看不见的骨架。SkyWalking、Pinpoint 以及 OpenTelemetry 的 Java agent 会在 JDBC 连接、Servlet 入口和 RPC 客户端周围注入链路追踪与指标采集；Mockito 的 inline mock maker 用它来 mock final 类与静态方法；JaCoCo 借助即时转换器统计覆盖率；JRebel 与 HotSwapAgent 则用它热加载改动后的类——但受一条铁律约束：重定义可以改方法体，却不能增删方法和字段。

有两项代价需要坦率说明。转换会给类加载增加工作量，从而拉长启动耗时；而一个写错的转换器可能在 bootstrap 阶段就把整个 JVM 卡死，因为它就运行在类加载路径上。所以要让 agent 可由开关控制，把高开销操作藏在配置后面，并在默认启用前先测清楚它带来的启动开销。
titleCn: Java Agent 与字节码增强

title: Safe Publication and Object Visibility
contentMd:
An object is published when a reference to it becomes visible to other threads. Unsafe publication lets another thread observe a partially constructed object, seeing default field values instead of the ones assigned in the constructor, because both the compiler and the hardware are permitted to reorder stores and to make them visible out of order.

The Java Memory Model fixes this through happens-before relationships. Static initialization, volatile writes followed by reads, releasing a monitor before a later acquire, Thread.start, Thread.join, and operations on concurrent collections all create those edges. In practice, publishing through a volatile field, through a synchronized getter and setter pair, through a BlockingQueue, or through a truly immutable object with final fields all make the state safely visible.

Final field semantics deserve their own mention. Writing final fields in the constructor and then publishing the reference guarantees readers see those values, provided the this reference never escapes during construction. Publishing this from a constructor, by registering a listener or starting a thread, is one of the most common concurrency bugs in real code, because the listener can start calling methods on an object that is not finished being built.

Two classic examples close the topic. Double-checked locking was broken for years until the instance field was declared volatile, since otherwise a thread could read a non-null reference to a still uninitialized object; today the initialization-on-demand holder idiom or simply a single-element enum removes the subtlety entirely. And remember that volatile gives visibility plus atomicity for single reads and writes, but does not make check-then-act sequences atomic.
contentCn:
当一个对象的引用变得对其他线程可见时，就称这个对象被发布了。不安全的发布会让另一个线程看到一个「半成品」对象：字段是默认值，而不是构造函数里赋的值，因为编译器和硬件都被允许重排写操作，并让它们以乱序变得可见。

Java 内存模型通过 happens-before 关系来解决这个问题。静态初始化、volatile 写之后的读、先释放管程再获取锁、Thread.start、Thread.join，以及对并发集合的操作都会建立这种边。实践中，通过 volatile 字段发布、通过成对的 synchronized getter/setter 发布、通过 BlockingQueue 发布，或者干脆发布一个字段全为 final 的不可变对象，都能让状态安全地可见。

final 字段的语义值得单独强调。在构造函数里写 final 字段然后发布该引用，可以保证读取方一定能看到那些值，前提是构造期间 this 引用从未逃逸出去。而在构造函数中发布 this——注册监听器、启动线程——是真实代码中最常见的并发缺陷之一，因为监听器可能在一个还没构造完的对象上就开始调用方法。

用两个经典例子收尾。双重检查锁定曾经是错的，直到把实例字段声明为 volatile，否则线程可能读到一个指向尚未初始化对象的非空引用；如今改用「按需初始化持有者」惯用法，或者干脆用单元素枚举实现单例，就把这些微妙之处完全消除了。还要记住：volatile 只提供可见性以及单次读写的原子性，并不能让「先检查后执行」这类复合操作变成原子操作。
titleCn: 安全发布与对象可见性

title: final vs finally vs finalize
contentMd:
final is a restriction applied to variables, methods and classes: variables cannot be reassigned after initialization, methods cannot be overridden, and classes cannot be extended. Beyond sealing intent, it has a deeper meaning in the memory model, because correctly constructed final fields are visible to other threads without any additional synchronization.

finally is a block attached to try. Its body runs however the try block exits: normally, by return, by break, or by a thrown exception. That makes it the correct home for releasing resources and for unlocking manually acquired locks. It also hides a trap: if finally contains a return statement, that value overrides the return from try and swallows any exception currently propagating, which produces bugs that are extremely hard to spot.

A third word sounding almost identical is completely unrelated. finalize was the method on Object called by a dedicated finalizer thread before an object was reclaimed. It ran at an unpredictable time, its presence promoted the object for an extra collection cycle, and any reference resurrected there revived the object indefinitely. It has been deprecated for removal since JDK 9, and replaced by Cleaner or by try-with-resources, which closes resources in reverse order and preserves suppressed exceptions instead of losing them.
contentCn:
final 是施加在变量、方法和类上的限制：变量初始化后不可再赋值，方法不可被覆盖，类不可被继承。除了表达「不打算改动」的意图之外，它在内存模型中还有更深的含义：被正确构造出来的 final 字段，无需任何额外同步就能对其他线程可见。

finally 是挂在 try 后面的代码块。无论 try 以何种方式退出——正常结束、return、break，还是抛出异常——它的内容都会执行。这使它成为释放资源、解锁手动获取锁的正确位置。但它也藏着一个陷阱：如果 finally 里有 return 语句，这个返回值会覆盖 try 中的返回，并吞掉正在传播的异常，由此造成的缺陷极难定位。

第三个发音相近的词则完全无关。finalize 曾是 Object 上的一个方法，在对象被回收前由专门的终结线程调用。它执行时间不可预测，它的存在会让对象多活一个回收周期，而在其中「复活」引用甚至能让对象无限存活下去。自 JDK 9 起它已被标记为待移除，取而代之的是 Cleaner，或者更推荐的 try-with-resources——后者按相反顺序关闭资源，并把被抑制的异常保留下来而不是丢弃。

title: String Constant Pool and intern()
contentMd:
The string pool is a table of interned String objects maintained by the JVM and, since JDK 7, located in the heap rather than PermGen. Every literal appearing in your source is interned when its class is loaded, and javac folds compile-time-constant concatenation such as a plus b in source into the combined literal before any bytecode is emitted.

String.intern() returns the canonical instance from that table, inserting the string if it is not already present. Because the pool is global, interning is also a synchronization point: threads calling intern compete on the same table structure. Older JDKs used a fixed bucket count that never resized, turning indiscriminate interning of millions of distinct strings into a slow disaster; modern JDKs handle it far better, but the fundamental costs of shared global state and retained references remain.

For a bounded set owned by one component, prefer your own ConcurrentHashMap cache or Guava Interner with weak references, so the lifetime is yours to control instead of the JVM's. Use intern deliberately when you have a small, hot set of repeated values such as column names, statuses or codes, where deduplication measurably saves memory.

The interview trap is identity versus equality. Strings built at runtime (new String of a literal, StringBuilder output, values read from IO) are ordinary heap objects, not pooled instances, so comparing them with == fails where equals succeeds. Always compare strings with equals. The mirror-image fact is retention: each interned string is held for the life of the JVM, so interning unbounded user input is a slow leak, while simply calling intern on a literal gains nothing because literals are pooled already.
contentCn:
字符串常量池是 JVM 维护的一张存放已驻留（interned）String 对象的表，自 JDK 7 起它位于堆中而非永久代。源码中出现的每个字面量都会在其类被加载时驻留；而对于编译期常量的拼接，javac 会在生成字节码之前就把结果合并成单个字面量。

String.intern() 会返回该表中的规范实例，若尚不存在则将其插入。由于这张表是全局的，intern 同时也是一个同步点：调用 intern 的多个线程会在同一张表结构上竞争。早期 JDK 使用固定且不会扩容的桶数组，于是对海量不同字符串滥用 intern 就会演变成一场缓慢的性能灾难；现代 JDK 处理得好得多，但「全局共享状态」与「强引用长期保留」这两项固有代价依然存在。

对于某个组件独占且有界的取值集合，更推荐用自己维护的 ConcurrentHashMap 缓存，或使用基于弱引用的 Guava Interner，让生命周期由你掌控而不是交给 JVM。当你手上是一个规模小、重复度高且访问频繁的取值集合——列名、状态码、业务编码等——刻意使用 intern 往往能通过去重实实在在地省下内存。

面试陷阱在于同一性与相等性。运行期才构造出来的字符串——new String 包字面量、StringBuilder 的输出、从 IO 读到的值——都只是普通的堆对象，并不是池中实例，因此用 == 比较会失败而 equals 会成功。字符串一律用 equals 比较。与之相对的事实是驻留带来的持有：每个被驻留的字符串都会被持有到 JVM 结束，所以对用户导入的无界输入做 intern 是一种缓慢泄漏；而对字面量直接调 intern 也毫无收益，因为字面量本来就已经在池里了。

title: The Integer Cache and Boxed Comparison Traps
contentMd:
Integer.valueOf caches boxed instances for values from -128 to 127 by default, populating the cache on first use. The upper bound can be widened with -XX:AutoBoxCacheMax, while the lower bound is fixed. Inside that range valueOf returns a shared object, so two boxed Integers with equal values compare true with ==. Outside it, each call allocates a new object and == returns false even though the numeric values are identical.

This explains the canonical puzzle: assigning 100 to two Integer variables and comparing them with == is true, while doing the same with 200 is false. Short, Byte, Long and Character implement the same -128 to 127 cache, and Boolean always returns the shared TRUE or FALSE constants. The mechanical rule is therefore to compare boxed numerics with equals, or to unbox to primitives before comparing.

A related trap hides inside auto-unboxing itself. Unboxing a null wrapper during arithmetic or comparison throws NullPointerException, and it surfaces in places people do not expect: a Map.get that returned null being incremented by a counting lambda, a ternary expression mixing a primitive and a wrapper which silently unboxes the whole expression, or a DTO field left unset and then compared. Note also that the cache applies to valueOf, not to new Integer, which always allocates a distinct object and defeats the cache entirely.
contentCn:
Integer.valueOf 默认会缓存 -128 到 127 范围内的装箱实例，缓存在使用时惰性填充。上界可以用 -XX:AutoBoxCacheMax 扩大，下界则固定不变。在这个范围内 valueOf 返回共享对象，因此两个取值相等的 Integer 用 == 比较会得到 true；超出该范围则每次调用都会分配新对象，即使数值完全相同，== 也会返回 false。

这正是那个经典谜题的成因：给两个 Integer 变量赋 100 再用 == 比较是 true，而同样赋 200 就比较为 false。Short、Byte、Long 和 Character 都实现了同样的 -128 到 127 缓存，Boolean 则始终返回共享的 TRUE 或 FALSE 常量。因此铁律是：装箱数值之间一律用 equals 比较，或者先拆箱成基本类型再比较。

与之相关的另一个陷阱藏在自动拆箱本身。在算术运算或比较中拆箱一个 null 包装类会抛出 NullPointerException，而且它常常出现在人们没料到的地方：某个返回 null 的 Map.get 被计数用的 lambda 自增时；一个混用了基本类型与包装类的三元表达式让整个表达式被悄悄拆箱时；或某个未赋值的 DTO 字段被拿去做比较时。还要注意缓存只作用于 valueOf 而非 new Integer——后者总是分配独立对象，完全绕过缓存。
titleEn: The Integer Cache and Boxed Comparison Traps
titleCn: Integer 缓存与装箱比较陷阱

title: What Exceptions Really Cost
contentMd:
Entering a try block is essentially free; the cost is paid when a throwable is constructed. The dominant expense is fillInStackTrace, which walks every frame and snapshots them into metadata. That means the cost scales with stack depth, so a deep call chain makes each thrown exception dramatically more expensive than a shallow one.

When you genuinely do not need the trace, you can remove that cost: use the protected constructor with writableStackTrace disabled, or override fillInStackTrace to return this. This is a legitimate technique for control-flow oriented exceptions inside hot libraries, but apply it deliberately, because losing the stack removes your ability to diagnose failures later, and the same instance shared across threads carries confusing state.

The real anti-pattern is exception-driven control flow. Throwing is appropriate for genuinely exceptional events, not for outcomes that occur on most requests: no such row found, validation failed, retry, user not found. Use Optional, sentinel results, or result objects for those, and reserve exceptions for cases where the caller is expected to stop what it is doing.

Finally, discipline around handling matters more than micro-cost. Do not swallow exceptions with an empty catch, do not log and rethrow at every layer so the same failure appears six times, always preserve the cause when wrapping in a domain exception, and never absorb InterruptedException without calling Thread.currentThread().interrupt() so that upstream cancellation can still work.
contentCn:
进入 try 块本身几乎不花代价，开销是在构造 throwable 时产生的。其中最大的一笔是 fillInStackTrace：它会逐帧遍历调用栈并把它们快照进元数据。这意味着开销随栈的深度线性增长，因此在很深的调用链上抛异常，要比在浅栈上昂贵得多。

当你确实不需要栈信息时，可以把这笔开销去掉：使用禁用 writableStackTrace 的保护构造器，或者覆写 fillInStackTrace 让它返回 this。这对于热点类库中偏「控制流」用途的异常是正当手段，但务必有意为之——丢了栈就等于失去了日后定位故障的能力，而且同一实例被多线程共用时还会带来混乱的状态。

真正的反模式是「用异常驱动控制流」。抛异常适用于真正异常的事件，而不适用于那些在多数请求上都会发生的结果：查不到记录、校验失败、需要重试、用户不存在。这些场景应当使用 Optional、哨兵返回值或结果对象，把异常留给调用方本来就该中止当前操作的情形。

最后，调用与处理的纪律比微性能更重要。不要用空 catch 吞掉异常；不要每层都既打日志又往上抛，让同一个故障出现六遍；包装成领域异常时一定要保留 cause；吞掉 InterruptedException 时必须调用 Thread.currentThread().interrupt()，好让上层的取消机制仍然有效。
